workouts.title: MUM 1.1 (Week 1, Workout 1)
workouts.description: "Without a struggle, there can be no progress." - Frederick Douglass

items.movement: 3-5min Bike, Row, or Run (a little movement to get the blood flowing)
30-45sec x Chest Smash each side (KB or Lax ball)
30-45sec x Banded Shoulder Extension each side
3-5 x "Super Deep" Ring Dip w/ pause at bottom
5-8 x Banded Strict Muscle Up Attempts
Use band heavy enough to get you over the rings at least once!
If possible, chose a collection of smaller bands instead of one super thick one.
3-5min Bike, Row, or Run (a little movement to get the blood flowing)
Bonus: do a "negative" after each Jumping Muscle Up
Record the weight used so we can continue to increase it in the coming weeks.
If you are easily getting 8 reps, increase your weight or slow down your tempo!
3-5min Bike, Row, or Run (a little movement to get the blood flowing)
30-45sec x Chest Smash each side (KB or Lax ball)
30-45sec x Banded Shoulder Extension each side
3-5min Bike, Row, or Run (a little movement to get the blood flowing)
Accumulate 10-20 sec x Closed Fist False Grip Ring Hold
Go for max reps unbroken on 3rd set
No strict C2B? Substitute normal strict pull-ups
3-5 reps x Strict Deep Ring Dips
Go for max reps unbroken on 3rd set
10 total reps x Banded Ring Pull-Down

workouts.title: MUM 2.3 (Week 2, Workout 3)
workouts.description: Let's continue building on our strength for ring muscle ups. You'll notice that these exercises have a tempo associated with them. If you have never used tempo before review the image below or click it to watch Coach Ben explain it in more detail. Do you best to follow the prescribed tempo and make sure you note of any weight used so we can build on it in the coming weeks.

items.movement: 1 second pause at the top, 2 seconds down
Use a PVC pipe, dumbbell or unweighted barbell. Whichever allows you to complete the reps but stay challenging.

workouts.title: Muscle Up Road Map 2.0
workouts.description: Muscle Up Road Map was a special guide we released that you can get access to here. You can also download the full infographic poster and the Muscle Up Road Map Guide from under the Files tab.

items.movement: 3-5min Bike, Row, or Run (a little movement to get the blood flowing)
30-45sec x Chest Smash each side (KB or Lax ball)
30-45sec x Banded Shoulder Extension each side
Lever + 1 x Elevate + 1 x Hips to Rings
Aim to perform as an unbroken complex
3-5min Bike, Row, or Run (a little movement to get the blood flowing)
Every min: Slow Muscle Up + 2 Transitions
See how to link two bands together for the Banded Strict Muscle Ups
Record the weight used so we can continue to increase it in the coming weeks.
If you are easily getting 8 reps, increase your weight or slow down your tempo!
3-5min Bike, Row, or Run (a little movement to get the blood flowing)
30-45sec x Chest Smash each side (KB or Lax ball)
30-45sec x Banded Shoulder Extension each side
Lever + 1 x Elevate + 1 x Hips to Rings
3-5min Bike, Row, or Run (a little movement to get the blood flowing)
"Sub-Max Effort" Strict Chest to bar Pull-ups
"Sub Max Effort" = stop approximately 2 reps from failure. If you cannot do strict C2B, scale to normal strict pull-ups. NO KIPPING!

sections.name: BOUNCE & GO
sections.format: Play with this drill for 5-10minutes; Focus on quality, not quantity

items.movement: *1 second pause at the top, 2 seconds down
Use a PVC pipe, dumbbell or unweighted barbell. Whichever allows you to complete the reps but stay challenging.

workouts.title: MUM 5.1 (Week 5, Workout 1)
workouts.description: Today you will be using a partner for some of the drills. If you can't find a partner, then please utilize the use of a band instead.

sections.name: WARM UP

items.movement: 30-45sec x Chest Smash each side (KB or Lax ball)
30-45sec x Banded Shoulder Extension each side

sections.notes: 3-5min Bike, Row, or Run (a little movement to get the blood flowing)

items.movement: Pull as high as possible. Ideally pulling to the sternum.
Aim between 5-25lbs. Record weight so you can build on it.
1-3 x Partner Assisted Strict Muscle Up
Focus on PERFECT form! Use the extra support to eliminate bad habits like chicken wings, loose core, and slow transitions. No partner? Preform 2-5 x Banded Strict Muscle Ups
3-5min Bike, Row, or Run (a little movement to get the blood flowing)

sections.name: TRANSITION WORK
sections.format: 1 Set; Every 30 seconds for 5 minutes (10 Total Sets):

sections.name: RIP & KIP (OPTIONAL)

items.movement: For those who can already do muscle ups, use these attempts to eliminate your bad habits. Avoid chicken wings, slow transitions, and other "Fault Fixer" problems

sections.format: Feel like you are ready for something more challenging?

items.movement: Record the weight used and aim to increase from MUM 3.3
If you are easily getting 8 reps, increase your weight or slow down your tempo!
3-5min Bike, Row, or Run (a little movement to get the blood flowing)
30-45sec x Chest Smash each side (KB or Lax ball)
30-45sec x Banded Shoulder Extension each side
Lever + 1 x Elevate + 1 x Hips to Rings + 1 x "Perfect" Muscle Up/ attempt
Perform all of these drills with a paper or knee sleeve in between your feet the entire time. You may drop and reset before the muscle up attempt.
If you can do multiple muscle ups, then try to do 2-3 unbroken muscle ups at the end of this complex each round.
3-5min Bike, Row, or Run (a little movement to get the blood flowing)
Sit in a band heavy enough for you to complete at least one rep!
*1 second pause at the top, 2 seconds down
*Use a PVC pipe, dumbbell or unweighted barbell. Whichever allows you to complete the reps but stay challenging.
3-5min Bike, Row, or Run (a little movement to get the blood flowing)
30-45sec x Chest Smash each side (KB or Lax ball)
30-45sec x Banded Shoulder Extension each side
3-5min Bike, Row, or Run (a little movement to get the blood flowing)
Every min: 1 x Banded Muscle Up + 3 x Transitions (slow)
Lever + 1 x Elevate + 1 x Hips to Rings *
If you can do kipping muscle ups, add "+ 1 Kipping Muscle Up" to the end of the complex
Aim to increase weight from last time in MUM 5.3
If you are easily getting 8 reps, increase your weight or slow down your tempo!
3-5min Bike, Row, or Run (a little movement to get the blood flowing)
30-45sec x Chest Smash each side (KB or Lax ball)
30-45sec x Banded Shoulder Extension each side
Heavy Weighted Ring Pull-ups with false grip.
Pull as high as possible. Aim to increase weight from MUM 5.2
Film strict Muscle Ups for post review
3-5min Bike, Row, or Run (a little movement to get the blood flowing)
Lever + 1 x Elevate + 1 x Hips to Rings + 1 x Kipping Muscle Up Attempt

You should only try 3 attempts during today's workout. Please don't do any more than 3 attempts! If you already have muscle ups, you can change the complex to include "Max Effort Unbroken Muscle Ups" instead.
